title: Logical Reasoning
parentNote: This section is worth only 5 marks in the real ICSO paper (out of 35 questions), but it warms up the same thinking skills used everywhere else in the exam. If your child has already done the Maths Olympiad reasoning units, this will feel familiar — that's intentional!
learnBullets: Finding the **odd one out** in a group
Completing **analogies** (A is to B as C is to ___)
learnItFirst:
This unit mixes ALL the reasoning skills tested in Section 1 of the real ICSO exam, a little bit of each:

| Skill | What to look for |
|---|---|
| Pattern | What small group of things keeps repeating? |
| Odd One Out | What do 3 of them share that the 4th doesn't? |
| Analogy | What is the connection between the first pair? |
| Ranking | Who/what comes first, tallest, heaviest? |
| Coding | What rule turns one letter/number into another? |

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Read** the question twice before looking at the options.
2. **Say the rule out loud** in your own words.
3. **Test** your rule against the options before picking one.

questions.why: Blue, Green repeats — after Blue (7th) comes Green

questions.content: 🍎 🍌 🍇 🚌 — which one does not belong?
questions.why: The rest are fruits; a bus is a vehicle

questions.content: Which is longer — a pencil ✏️ or a school bus 🚌?
questions.why: A bus is much bigger and longer than a pencil

questions.content: How many sides does a square have?
questions.why: A square always has 4 sides

questions.content: Bird is to Nest as Bee is to ___
questions.why: A bird lives in a nest; a bee lives in a hive

questions.content: Tom is taller than Sam. Sam is taller than Rai. Who is the TALLEST?
questions.why: Tom > Sam > Rai, so Tom is the tallest

questions.content: Which of these belongs to the group of ROUND shapes: ▲ ● ■?
questions.why: A circle is the only round shape here

questions.content: If CAT is coded as DBU (each letter shifts forward by 1), how is DOG coded?
questions.why: D→E, O→P, G→H (each letter moves 1 forward)

questions.content: A house picture is made of a triangle (roof) on top of a square (body). What shape is the ROOF?
questions.why: The pointed top part of the house is a triangle
Add 2 each time: 8 + 2 = 10
▲, ● repeats — the 5th spot lines up with ▲

questions.content: 2, 4, 6, 7 — which number does not belong?
questions.why: 2, 4, 6 are even numbers; 7 is odd

questions.content: Which unit is used to measure weight?
questions.why: Weight is measured in kilograms

questions.content: How many corners does a pentagon have?
questions.why: A pentagon has 5 corners

questions.content: Cow is to Calf as Dog is to ___
questions.why: A dog's baby is called a puppy

questions.content: In a queue of 6 children, Meena is 3rd from the left. What is her position counted from the right?
questions.why: Position from right = 6 − 3 + 1 = 4th

questions.content: Group 1 (4 sides): ■ ▬. Group 2 (3 sides): ▲. A diamond ◆ (4 sides) belongs to:
questions.why: A diamond has 4 sides, matching Group 1's rule

questions.content: If A=1, B=2, C=3, what is C + B?
A robot picture is made of 1 square (head) + 1 rectangle (body) + 2 circles (eyes). How many shapes in total?
questions.why: 1 square + 1 rectangle + 2 circles = 4 shapes
Add 5 each time: 20 + 5 = 25

questions.content: 🐄 🐐 🐔 🐴 — three have 4 legs. Which one does not belong?
questions.why: The rest have 4 legs; a hen has 2 legs

questions.content: Which holds more water — a bucket 🪣 or a cup ☕?
questions.why: A bucket is much bigger than a cup

questions.content: Which shape has NO corners at all?
questions.why: A circle is round and smooth, with no corners

questions.content: Pen is to Writing as Scissors is to ___
questions.why: Scissors are used for cutting

questions.content: A is heavier than B. B is heavier than C. Who is the LIGHTEST?
questions.why: A > B > C in weight, so C is the lightest
The jump grows each time: +2, +3, +4, then +5 → 10 + 5 = 15

questions.content: In a code, words are written BACKWARDS. "CAT" is coded as "TAC". How is "DOG" coded?
questions.why: Reading "DOG" backwards gives "GOD"

questions.content: In a line, Neha is 2nd from the left and 5th from the right. How many children are in the line in total?
questions.why: Total = 2 (from left) + 5 (from right) − 1 = 6

questions.content: A rocket picture is made of 1 nose triangle + 2 fin triangles. How many triangles in total?
questions.why: 1 nose triangle + 2 fin triangles = 3

questions.content: Group 1 (even numbers): 2, 4, 6. Group 2 (odd numbers): 1, 3, 5. The number 10 belongs to:
questions.why: 10 is an even number
